style: Duo sitcom in Maya's room, morning daylight until the lamp click in beat 5, then night with moon, stars and desk lamp glow. Maya (round glasses, pencil bun) sits behind the desk with Floey perched on the laptop lid facing her. Warm room palette, with Flowra pink and amber captions. One room prop carries the number all reel: a red '-60%' pill (Maya's own example, not real data) by her head that flips to a green '+2%'. One cutaway insert only: the Search Console clicks chart in beat 3. No notification.

panels.subject: mayaTight: Maya in the mug pose, panic face, eyes wide behind round glasses. The red '-60%' DUO.stat pill sits moved inward beside her head, fully inside the tight frame at phone size
panels.action: Frame one, problem already happening: she leans back from the laptop clutching the mug and says 'Floey. My clicks...' mid panic. The pill is already up

panels.subject: mayaTight: Maya, mug pose, panic face, red pill beside her head
panels.action: On 'cliff' she jolts in the chair. The bun pencil wobbles and the mug stays in her hand. A small shake for real panic

panels.subject: wide: Maya behind the desk in the mug pose, Floey perched on the laptop lid facing her, red pill still by Maya's head
panels.action: Pull-out to the two-shot on 'Sixty percent'. Maya leans toward Floey (look x -1). Floey sits totally unbothered and turns her head slowly toward Maya

panels.subject: floeyTight: Floey alone on the laptop lid, mood think
panels.action: Cut to the speaker. Floey tilts her head and calmly asks 'Is the end of the line dotted?', then gives one small wink on 'dotted'

panels.subject: maya: Maya alone, worried and annoyed face. DUO.mug() now stands on the desk. The red pill stays by her head
panels.action: She sets the mug down with a clunk and switches to the point pose, jabbing toward the screen at screen right. Her voice rises on 'It's falling!' and the bun pencil wobbles

panels.subject: wide: Floey on the lid, Maya behind the desk in the rest pose, mug on the desk, red pill by her head
panels.action: Floey tilts her head down toward the screen side as she starts 'In Search Console...'. Maya, the listener, leans in toward the laptop (look x 0, y 1) and her face shifts from worried to think

panels.subject: The single cutaway: DUO.screenInsert of the laptop screen, a 24 hour chart titled 'Clicks', labelled 'Hourly'. The line runs steady, then the last stretch dives
panels.action: The insert swings in on 'dotted means Google's still counting'. It zooms into the tail and lands so the dive reads clearly as a dotted segment while the rest of the line stays solid. A soft tick as the zoom lands. Hold it through 'Look again in a few hours'

panels.subject: mayaTight: Maya in the chin (think) pose, leaning toward the screen, red pill beside her head, mug untouched on the desk
panels.action: Push-in for the realisation. Her eyes narrow on the dots on 'Wait...', then on 'it is dotted' her shoulders drop (MY.slump) and her face eases from think to sheepish

panels.subject: floeyTight: Floey alone on the laptop lid, mood happy, eyes half closed
panels.action: Floey preens one wing without looking up and says 'Good. Now drink your coffee.' dry and offhand

panels.subject: wide: the same frame, with Maya in the same chair and the same lean, mug untouched on the desk, Floey on the lid. Window turns to night with moon and stars
panels.action: Time passes in the gap after the line (GAP about 1.8 s). Hard cut from the day set to the night set on the desk lamp click. Lamp glow pools on the desk and nobody has moved, which is the joke

panels.subject: maya: Maya at night in the rest pose, lamp glow on one side, red '-60%' pill by her head
panels.action: She blinks at the screen (look y 1) and says 'Oh. It filled back in.' Her face goes from surprised to relieved

panels.subject: maya: Maya, rest pose, pill beside her head
panels.action: On 'Up two percent' the pill flips from red '-60%' to green '+2%' with one soft ding. A gentle push-in as her face turns relieved and a bit sheepish, with a small embarrassed smile

panels.subject: maya: Maya picks the mug up (mug pose). DUO.mug() is removed from the desk, so there is one mug only. The green pill fades out
panels.action: Her face goes flat and deadpan right at the start of 'Ugh. It's cold.' She sips, then stares down into the mug. One small slurp

panels.subject: floeyTight: Floey on the laptop lid, F.pivot to 'front', mood deadpan think
panels.action: Floey pivots to face the lens and delivers 'Sorry, Maya. The coffee isn't dotted.' straight down the camera, then gives one tongue flick after 'dotted'

panels.subject: mayaTight: Maya in the mug pose, deadpan, cold mug held at her chin
panels.action: Button: cut to the listener. Maya slowly raises her eyes to the camera and gives a long silent look. END is pushed back about 1.5 s so the look plays out, then the end card lands with Floey perched beside the Flowra logo
